scope: The Kebra Nagast whole in Ge'ez as Beta maṣāḥǝft edits it. Carl Bezold's critical edition (Kebra Nagast: Die Herrlichkeit der Könige, Abhandlungen der Königlich Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, 1905) is public domain and was not found in an open scan in this pass: QUEUED. Budge's English (1922) is a translation and is not seated.

why_seated: The Ethiopian national epic of Solomon, the Queen of Sheba and their son Menelik, who carries the Ark of the Covenant to Aksum: the book that tells how the canon beside it came to Ethiopia. Seated with the canon (EA-CORPORA-20/01).
ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-23: "detour for an ea-corpora seating. lets see. whats available of mayan texts? and then i dont think we have much or any deuterocanonical second temple lit - all those apocalypses. and what about the ethiopian canon? and euclid. all in original language or as close to it as possible. what else?" — "and the Egyptian book of the dead" — "and what about the fragments of the book of balaam?" — "yes yes yes to all - what a meal."
